title: Past Simple or Continuous?
ringkas: Kejadian selesai vs kejadian yang sedang berlangsung, when dan while
goals: memakai **past simple** untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai di masa lampau
memakai **past continuous** untuk kejadian yang sedang berlangsung pada satu saat di masa lampau
memakai **when** dan **while** untuk menggabungkan dua kejadian
membedakan kejadian latar (background) dan kejadian pendek yang memotong

lesson.text: Saat bercerita tentang masa lalu, kita memakai dua tense utama. **Past simple** untuk kejadian yang selesai (*I called her.*). **Past continuous** untuk kejadian yang **sedang berlangsung** pada satu saat (*I was cooking when she called.*).

examples.en: [[She arrived at six and ate dinner.]]
examples.id: Dia tiba pukul enam dan makan malam. (urutan kejadian selesai)

examples.en: [[At eight last night, I was watching TV.]]
examples.id: Pukul delapan tadi malam, aku sedang menonton TV.

lesson.title: 3. when dan while
table: [[While I was cooking, the phone rang.]]
[[I was cooking when the phone rang.]]
[[While I was cooking, he was reading.]]

examples.en: [[I was walking home when it started to rain.]]
examples.id: Aku sedang berjalan pulang ketika hujan mulai turun. (berjalan = latar; hujan = memotong)

lesson.title: Kejadian latar dan kejadian memotong
lesson.text: Bayangkan film. **Past continuous** adalah latar belakang yang berjalan (*was walking*). **Past simple** adalah kejadian pendek yang memotong (*started to rain*). Tanya: mana yang panjang dan mana yang pendek?

lesson.title: Kata kerja keadaan tetap past simple
lesson.text: Katakan [[I knew the answer.]], bukan ~~I was knowing the answer~~. Dan untuk urutan kejadian selesai, pakai past simple semua: [[She came in, sat down, and opened her book.]]

read.text:
Rani: Where were you yesterday afternoon?
Tom: I was walking home when it started to rain.
Rani: Oh no! Did you get wet?
Tom: Yes, I did. While I was running, I dropped my phone.
Rani: Did it break?
Tom: No, it didn't. A boy picked it up and gave it back.
read.title: A Rainy Afternoon

read.id: Sabtu lalu, listrik padam pukul tujuh malam. Aku sedang mengerjakan PR, dan adikku sedang menonton TV. Tiba-tiba, semuanya gelap. Kami menyalakan lilin dan bermain kartu. Sementara kami bermain, tetangga kami mengetuk pintu. Mereka membawa kue besar, karena itu hari jadi mereka. Kami memakannya bersama dalam cahaya lilin.

read.text: Last Saturday, the power went out at seven in the evening. I was doing my homework, and my sister was watching TV. Suddenly, everything went dark. We lit candles and played cards. While we were playing, our neighbors knocked on the door. They were carrying a big cake, because it was their anniversary. We ate it together in the candlelight.
read.title: The Day the Power Went Out

read.id:
Officer: Di mana Anda pukul delapan tadi malam?
Witness: Saya sedang mengajak anjing saya jalan-jalan di taman.
Officer: Apakah Anda melihat sesuatu?
Witness: Ya. Sementara saya berjalan, saya melihat seorang pria berlari.
Officer: Apa yang sedang dia lakukan?
Witness: Dia sedang membawa tas, dan dia menjatuhkannya ketika mendengar suara.
Officer: Terima kasih. Itu sangat membantu.

read.text:
Officer: Where were you at eight last night?
Witness: I was walking my dog in the park.
Officer: Did you see anything?
Witness: Yes. While I was walking, I saw a man running.
Officer: What was he doing?
Witness: He was carrying a bag, and he dropped it when he heard a noise.
Officer: Thank you. That is very helpful.
read.title: Where Were You at Eight?
